vulnerability.explanation: The function builds a caret line in a fixed buffer content[81]. After copying up to 80 bytes and NUL-terminating, it reuses variable n as the loop index: for (n = 0; n < col; n++) ...; content[n++] = '^'; content[n] = 0;. If xmlParserInputGetWindow returns col == 80 (the maximum window size), content[n++] = '^' writes at index 80 (within bounds), but the subsequent content[n] = 0 writes at index 81, one past the end of the 81-byte buffer, causing a 1-byte stack overflow. This can be triggered by an input that produces an error with the current column at the end of the 80-character window.
